text:
ada: CI shard turned red for hosted integration tests — seeing intermittent 401s and a schema mismatch in tool-calling tests. Job: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/integ-hosted/5678 :eyes:
chris: I looked at the job logs briefly. 401 right after stream open, log shows 'auth: token missing' even though the test injects JWT. Could be startup race with auth-stub.
sam: which test names are failing?
ada: failing: test_toolcall_stream_auth_smoke and test_streaming_auth_schema. Minimal repro used in the test below:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello","tools":[{"name":"search","args":{}}]}' https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```
Response snippet from the failing run:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"auth.failed","details":"missing sub claim"}
```
chris: The harness spins up auth-stub and then runs tests. If auth-stub isn't fully ready, the first request might be rejected. Also saw in logs a schema validation error for toolcall responses (extra `metadata` field) in later tests.
maria: I restarted auth-stub on shard-3 and re-ran the job — it still flakes, sometimes green, sometimes red. I've attached the network trace to the CI job.
deploy-bot: Build 5679 queued by @ada -> https://ci.redwood.internal/job/integ-hosted/5679
sam: can we bisect between commits 6a1b2c..7f8e9d to see where the schema/behavior changed? ada, can you kick off a bisect run?
ada: started the bisect runner -> https://ci.redwood.internal/bisect/890. First bad commit appears at 6f2d1b2 — bisect logs point at a change in model adapter that began adding a `metadata` object to toolcall results; schema validator now rejects it.
chris: If the model adapter started returning extra fields, tests should either tolerate them or the validator should be updated. Quick mitigation: relax strict schema in the test harness for toolcall responses.
maria: I'll open a PR to mark these tests as flaky and add a retry/backoff in the harness while we sort out the adapter change. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/442
sam: oncall, can you rerun the failing job with a force-clean so the auth-stub definitely restarts? @ada
ada: rerunning job 5679 with --force-clean now.
infra-bot: Rerun started: job 5679 (user ada) - shard-3
chris: If the rerun still fails, collect the full host logs and the auth-stub debug dump: /var/log/hosted-api/hosted.log.gz and /tmp/auth-stub/debug.json
ada: rerun passed this time :party_parrot: marking the job green but I'm keeping INTEG-321 open for follow-up. Created issue: https://issues.redwood.internal/INTEG-321 - notes attached about intermittent auth startup timing and recent adapter change.
maria: I'll take ownership of the follow-up, will propose either schema compatibility fix or stricter adapter contract.
sam: thanks all — if it recurs, please ping #eng-incident and we'll triage immediately. :thumbsup:
